name: html-templates
description: Two HTML page templates for accept-or-reject review workflows: an editing page whose accepted edits are applied to LaTeX sources after a dry run, and a review page with the evidence under each point of a peer review.

interface.shortDescription: Accept-or-reject pages for proposed edits and reviews
interface.longDescription: Two HTML page templates for accept-or-reject review workflows: an editing page whose accepted edits are applied to LaTeX sources after a dry run, and a review page with the evidence under each point of a peer review.
defaultPrompt: Use $html-templates to put these proposed edits on an editing page so I can accept, reject, or reword each one before it is applied.
